blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein humne derivative ke sign se dekha ke graph kahan charhta hai aur kahan utarta hai. Ab sawal yeh hai: charhai se utraai mein badalne ki jagah kaun si hoti hai? Pahari raaste ki misaal phir lijiye: chotti par pohanch kar ek lamhe ke liye zameen bilkul seedhi (flat) hoti hai. Graph par aisi jagah ko stationary point kehte hain.
Kitab ki definition: graph ka woh point jahan us ka derivative zero ho, stationary point kehlata hai.

Ek rozmarra ki misaal: ek ball ko seedha upar phenkiye. Woh upar jate hue dheemi hoti jati hai, sab se ooncha point par ek lamhe ke liye us ki raftaar bilkul zero ho jati hai, aur phir neeche aane lagti hai. Height ke graph par woh lamha ek stationary point hai: wahan height ka derivative (yani raftaar) zero hai. Derivative zero matlab us lamhe tabdeeli ki shrah zero hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Stationary point par tangent line bilkul horizontal hoti hai (slope 0). Us lamhe graph na upar ja raha hai na neeche, jaise "ruka hua" ho; isi liye naam stationary (thehra hua) hai.
Hamari misaal: \(f(x) = x^{2}\) ke liye \(f'(x) = 2x\), aur \(2x = 0\) sirf \(x = 0\) par. To \((0, 0)\) stationary point hai; yeh parabola ka sab se neeche wala point hai.
Lekin har stationary point mor (turning point) nahin hota: \(g(x) = x^{3}\) mein \(g'(x) = 3x^{2}\), to \(g'(0) = 0\), phir bhi \(g\) 0 ke dono taraf barh raha hai. Graph wahan sirf ek pal ke liye seedha hota hai aur phir upar hi chalta rehta hai.

blocks.title: Numbering note
blocks.text: Kitab yahan "Example 16" ka number doosri dafa chhaapti hai; pehla Example 16 (\(f(x) = 2^{-x}\)) 2.9 mein hai. Hum printed number hi rakhte hain.

blocks.title: Example 16
blocks.problem: Find the intervals on which the function \(f(x) = |x|\), defined on \(\mathbb{R} = (-\infty, \infty)\), is increasing or decreasing.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = |x|\), poori real line par.
Maloom karna: woh intervals jahan \(f\) increasing ya decreasing hai.
Tareeqa: \(|x|\) ke do formule hain, ek \(x \ge 0\) ke liye aur ek \(x < 0\) ke liye. Har hisse ka derivative alag nikaalenge, \(x = 0\) (jahan dono formule milte hain) ko derivative ki definition se check karenge, phir dono taraf \(f'\) ka sign dekhenge.

Step 1: \(|x|\) ko tukron mein likhein
\[f(x) = |x| = \begin{cases} x & \text{if } x \ge 0 \\ -x & \text{if } x < 0 \end{cases}\]
Kyun: yeh modulus ki definition hai (Unit 1). Har tukra ek seedhi line hai jiska derivative aasaani se nikal aata hai.

Step 2: Har tukre ka derivative
\[f'(x) = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } x > 0 \\ -1 & \text{if } x < 0 \end{cases}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{d}{dx}(x) = 1\) aur \(\frac{d}{dx}(-x) = -1\). \(x = 0\) ko abhi chhor diya, kyun ke wahan formula badalta hai; us ka faisla alag se karna parega.

Step 3: \(f'(0)\) definition se
\[f'(0) = \lim_{h \to 0}\dfrac{f(0 + h) - f(0)}{h}\]
\[= \lim_{h \to 0}\dfrac{f(h) - 0}{h} = \lim_{h \to 0}\dfrac{|h|}{h}\]
Kyun: kisi point par derivative ki asal definition yahi limit hai. Jab formula seedha kaam na kare to definition par wapas jate hain.

Step 4: Left aur right limits alag alag
\[\lim_{h \to 0^{-}}\dfrac{|h|}{h} = \lim_{h \to 0^{-}}\dfrac{-h}{h} = -1\]
\[\lim_{h \to 0^{+}}\dfrac{|h|}{h} = \lim_{h \to 0^{+}}\dfrac{h}{h} = 1\]
Kyun: 0 ke left par \(h\) negative hai, wahan \(|h| = -h\); right par \(h\) positive hai, wahan \(|h| = h\). Do mukhtalif formule hain, is liye do one-sided limits.

Step 5: \(f'(0)\) exist nahin karta
Left limit \(-1\) aur right limit \(1\) barabar nahin, is liye \(\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{|h|}{h}\) exist nahin karti. Yani \(f'(0)\) defined nahin. Is liye \(x = 0\) ek critical point hai magar stationary point nahin.
Kyun: limit tabhi exist karti hai jab dono taraf ki limits ek jaisi hon. Graph par \(x = 0\) par ek nokeela kona (corner) hai, wahan koi ek tangent line nahin ban sakti.
Dhyan dein: kitab yahan sirf "x is a critical point" likhti hai; matlab \(x = 0\) hai (neeche "Kitab ki ghalti").

Step 6: Koi stationary point nahin
Jahan \(f'(x)\) exist karta hai wahan woh \(1\) ya \(-1\) hai, aur \(x = 0\) par exist hi nahin karta. Yani kahin bhi \(f'(x) = 0\) nahin: function ka koi stationary point nahin.
Kyun: stationary point ke liye derivative bilkul zero hona chahiye.

Step 7: Signs parhein
\[f'(x) = -1 < 0 \text{ on } (-\infty, 0)\]
\[f'(x) = 1 > 0 \text{ on } (0, \infty)\]
Kyun: 2.9 ka test: negative derivative yani decreasing, positive derivative yani increasing.

Tasdeeq: \(f(-3) = 3 > f(-1) = 1\) (left side par neeche aa raha hai) aur \(f(1) = 1 < f(3) = 3\) (right side par upar ja raha hai). \(|x|\) ka V-shape graph origin ke kone tak girta hai aur phir uthta hai: bilkul hamare jawab ke mutabiq.
blocks.answer: \(f(x) = |x|\) interval \((-\infty, 0)\) par decreasing aur \((0, \infty)\) par increasing hai; \(x = 0\) critical point hai (\(f'(0)\) exist nahin karta) magar stationary point nahin.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Numbers se dekhiye ke \(x = 0\) par kya ho raha hai. \(\frac{|h|}{h}\) mein \(h = -0.1\) rakhein: \(\frac{0.1}{-0.1} = -1\). \(h = -0.001\) rakhein: phir \(-1\). Ab \(h = 0.1\) ya \(h = 0.001\): har dafa \(+1\). Left se aate hue jawab hamesha \(-1\), right se aate hue hamesha \(+1\); dono kabhi ek jagah nahin milte.
Graph ki zabaan mein: \(|x|\) ka graph ek V hai. Left wali bazu ka slope \(-1\) hai aur right wali ka \(+1\). V ke neeche wale kone par aap kaunsa slope kahenge? Koi ek nahin. Jaise ek nala jis ki dono deewarein seedhi hon: tal (bottom) par khare ho kar aap nahin keh sakte ke zameen kis taraf jhuki hai. Isi liye wahan derivative exist nahin karta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 16 ke aakhir mein kitab "(\(\therefore\) x is a critical point but not stationary)" likhti hai. Point ka naam likhna chahiye tha: \(x = 0\) critical point hai magar stationary point nahin (kyun ke \(f'(0)\) exist nahin karta).

blocks.title: Critical Thinking
blocks.text:
Every stationary point is a critical point.
Do you think every critical point is a stationary point?

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Critical Thinking ka jawab: nahin. Critical point (agla sabaq 2.9.2) woh point hai jahan \(f'(c) = 0\) ho ya \(f'(c)\) exist hi na kare. Stationary point sirf pehli soorat hai. Example 16 mein \(x = 0\) par \(f'(0)\) exist nahin karta, is liye yeh critical point hai; lekin \(f'(0) = 0\) nahin, is liye stationary nahin. Yani har stationary point critical hai, magar har critical point stationary nahin.
Upar wale example mein function ka koi stationary point nahin, phir bhi woh ek aise point ke ird gird apna rawaiya badalta hai (ghatne se barhne lagta hai) jahan derivative undefined hai.

Natija (Conclusion): in examples se hum yeh seekhte hain ke function apna
1. increasing/decreasing hone ka rawaiya in jagahon ke ird gird badal sakta hai:

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Isi liye agle sabaq mein dono qisam ke points ko ek hi naam diya jata hai: critical points. Sirf yahi woh jagahein hain jahan barhta hua hissa ghatne lag sakta hai (ya ulta). Do critical points ke darmiyan \(f'\) ka sign badal nahin sakta, is liye har tukre mein sirf ek test point kaafi hota hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
\(f(x) = |x - 2|\) lijiye. Yeh \(|x|\) wala V hi hai, bas 2 unit right khiska hua.
\(x > 2\) par \(f(x) = x - 2\), to \(f'(x) = 1 > 0\): increasing. \(x < 2\) par \(f(x) = -(x - 2)\), to \(f'(x) = -1 < 0\): decreasing.
\(x = 2\) par kona hai: left limit \(-1\), right limit \(1\), is liye \(f'(2)\) exist nahin karta. Yani \(x = 2\) critical point hai magar stationary nahin, aur koi stationary point hai hi nahin.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Modulus wale function mein hamesha pehle us ko tukron mein likhiye, phir har tukre ka derivative. Jis point par tukre milte hain wahan \(h 	o 0^{-}\) aur \(h 	o 0^{+}\) wali dono limits likh kar dikhaiye; examiner yahi dekhta hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(f(x) = x^{2} - 4x\) ka stationary point kahan hai? (Jawab: \(f'(x) = 2x - 4 = 0\) se \(x = 2\); point \((2, -4)\). Yeh parabola ka sab se neeche wala point hai.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Stationary point: \(f'(x) = 0\); wahan tangent horizontal hoti hai.
2. \(f(x) = |x|\) ka koi stationary point nahin; \(f'(0)\) exist nahin karta kyun ke one-sided limits \(-1\) aur \(1\) hain.
3. \(|x|\) interval \((-\infty, 0)\) par decreasing aur \((0, \infty)\) par increasing hai.
4. Function ka rawaiya stationary point par ya us point par badal sakta hai jahan \(f'\) undefined ho.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(|x|\) ke liye \(f'(0) = 0\) likh dena, sirf is liye ke graph ka sab se neeche wala point wahan hai. Nokeele kone par derivative hota hi nahin.
2. Har stationary point ko mor (turning point) samajhna: \(x^{3}\) 0 par stationary hai magar barhta hi rehta hai.
3. Jahan formula badalta ho wahan sirf ek limit le lena; left aur right limits alag alag nikaaliye.
